permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Read the status feed from the Xaventra server you enter in the phone app, and send your yes/no answers and voice recordings to it. No other server is contacted.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional voice control: hold to speak. Audio is recorded only while you hold, for at most 15 seconds, and goes only to your own Xaventra server for transcription.
